package fixture

import (
	"context"

	"metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"
)

type localTenant struct{}

func (localTenant) FromContext(context.Context) (string, error) { return "", nil }

var _ = tenant.FromContext

// A block-local value named tenant must not be confused with the imported
// package. This is a non-violation even though the source selector matches.
func notATenantPackageCall(ctx context.Context) (string, string, error) {
	tenant := localTenant{}
	_, err := tenant.FromContext(ctx)
	return "", "", err
}
